messages:
Priya Rao: Hey team — onboarding new HF model to Redwood Dedicated. Conversion ran, but evaluation shows weird token splits in chat templates. I think tokenizer files mismatch.
Alex Nguyen: Can you paste the conversion logs? Wondering if tokenizer_config.json has different special tokens than tokenizer.json
Priya Rao: Logs: 
```
INFO: converting model... using fast tokenizer
WARN: tokenizer_config.json defines 'eos_token': ''
WARN: tokenizer.json has no '</s>' mapping
ERROR: decoding failed on eval set: unknown special token -> fallback to <unk>
```
Mateo Silva: That looks like a classic fast vs. slow mismatch — HF's `tokenizer.json` (rust/fast) sometimes doesn't include the same `special_tokens_map` as `tokenizer_config.json` (python). When Redwood falls back to slow loader we saw `<|endoftext|>` get mapped to `` and break chat templates. 
Jamie K.: Repro steps I ran locally:
```
# convert
python infra/convert_hf_to_redwood.py --model ./hf_repo --out ./redwood_bundle
# check
jq '.special_tokens_map' ./redwood_bundle/tokenizer_config.json
jq '.model' ./redwood_bundle/tokenizer.json
```
Output: tokenizer_config.json had `{"eos_token": ""}`, tokenizer.json had nothing. 
Li Chen: Is the upstream model using legacy special tokens in `tokenizer.json`? Sometimes HF stores specials inside `added_tokens.json` or the python `tokenizer_config.json` only. We should handle all sources.
Priya Rao: Agreed. Proposal: update convert script to merge specials from tokenizer_config.json, added_tokens.json, and the slow/tokenizer.py state into final tokenizer.json; emit warnings if any core specials missing (bos/sep/eos/pad/unk).
Alex Nguyen: +1. Quick patch I'll push: https://redwood.internal/pr/ML-391 — adds a `validate_specials()` step and a unit test.
Mateo Silva: Also add an eval gating check: if decoded sample length drops or `<unk>` rate > 0.5% on the smoke eval dataset, fail the onboarding.
Jamie K.: I can add the smoke eval and threshold. Will link to PR.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled by Alex Nguyen for branch fix/specials-merge at 2024-12-07 18:34:12 UTC :rocket:
Priya Rao: Thanks team. After PR lands, I'll re-run quantization sweep and report regressions.
Alex Nguyen: ETA for PR review: today EOD. I'll ping on #eng-ml when deployed. :thumbsup:
Li Chen: Can we also add a small doc in onboarding checklist about where HF splits specials (tokenizer.json vs tokenizer_config.json vs added_tokens.json) so new hires don't trip? 
Priya Rao: Yes — adding to onboarding doc and linking the check. https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/tokenizer-guidelines
